findings.title: Ten provisional patterns merge different accepted requirement sets

evidence.source_candidate_locator: Each occurrence lineage.candidate_source points to the exact pinned batch candidate row used for this comparison
evidence.impact: The merge is not reproducible from the declared required-match fields, and the canonical definitions overstate a shared full requirement boundary for occurrences that carry only a subset or a different sibling requirement. This is an unsupported pattern merge/definition under the work-order Major criteria.

findings.required_correction: Apply one reproducible merge contract. Under the frozen declared exact-key rule, split the ten patterns by accepted source-candidate requirement set while preserving response product and cognitive action. Rebuild pattern IDs, definitions, features, exclusions, examples, boundaries, occurrence assignments, counts, QA, manifests and handoff. A different semantic override requires an explicit A0-authorized rule and source-backed discriminators; definitions must no longer claim requirement identity that occurrences do not share.
findings.required_retest: Fresh independent reviewer must reconstruct every key from the pinned source-candidate rows, compare the complete partition with the catalog, and rerun all count, reference, source and sensitive-boundary checks.

findings.title: Six exact declared merge keys are split across two provisional patterns

evidence.impact: Occurrences with identical values for all three declared required-match fields do not resolve to one provisional pattern. The 498-row catalog and its partition cannot be regenerated from the published merge rule, which is a wrong catalog-boundary/count defect under the work-order Major criteria.

findings.required_correction: When correcting C3A-A3-MAJ-001, merge all occurrence partitions that have the same accepted requirement set, response product and cognitive action, unless A0 formally replaces the merge contract with a reproducible source-backed rule. Regenerate all dependent catalog/evidence artifacts and hashes.
findings.required_retest: Fresh independent reviewer must prove a one-to-one mapping between every reconstructed merge key and every provisional pattern and independently reproduce the resulting catalog count.

non_findings: No frozen input drift or output-closure mismatch
No locator or displayed-mark error in the required deterministic source sample
No container, unresolved or parent-context scoring promotion
No dangling or duplicate occurrence/marking identity
No final equivalence, final pattern status, predictive-frequency, split/holdout, lesson, translation, app or Stage 3 claim
